## Notes

### Quick read
- Stay at home mom of three with a clingy 18 month old daughter (Goldie), and Bambora's highest volume V3 creator: 62 videos, all approved, 57 run as ads, $8,215 GMV. Talky, confident yapper who sells hard on sales and the "Velcro baby" story.
- Best next move: check Discord for her reply to the Sep 18 message, then ask her (kindly) who the other moms in her montage videos are and whether they agreed to be in ads, and steer her new batches toward the safety check and arm relief angles instead of sale countdowns.

### Style (from watching her videos)
- On camera: late 20s/early 30s mom, tattooed forearms, long brown hair (worn down, bun, cap or blue bandana), usually with her blonde toddler girl on the hip. Third baby, "she's my third", carried since 5 months, now 17 to 18 months, named Goldie in 7d9d5538. Says she is a stay at home mom. Films in lots of places: a stone porch with a teal door and wreath, a closet/bedroom corner with shelves, a bedroom with a landscape painting, a wood cabinet kitchen, a living room with a pug, a camping trip (Jul 10). Owns 4+ slings (brown, houndstooth, leopard, navy floral, cream) plus the clip-on bag.
- Format: mostly yapper to camera, 25 to 45 seconds, captions burned in, fast and a bit sassy ("I'm freaking pissed", "what are you even doing", "thank me later"). Plus lots of 10 to 16 second text-only b-roll edits and montages set to music.
- Hooks she uses: "Okay, if you don't have a Velcro baby, just scroll away" (86dd4da4), "Tell me you're a breastfed baby without telling me" (23dd42e5), "Is it an addiction? I mean, probably" (db281646), "Why do I have so many Bambora Sling Carriers, you ask?" (3a68a35d), "I am freaking pissed that I wasted my money on this" (b27616b4, competitor comparison), "Okay, I feel so bad. If you were the mom in my DMs" (ecd22a7c), "Can you believe how fast these have blown up?" (d76f585a), "Okay, I'm running late for after-school pickup" (18bc5242), "If you have a baby shower to go to" (ca458daf), "Let's play a little game: what am I carrying in my clip-on bag?" (3d46d62a).
- Recurring angles: Velcro/clingy baby and mom guilt, getting chores done, one in every room and the car, "coordinate with my outfits", thick neck pad, 10 to 50 lbs so it lasts, clip-on bag replacing the diaper bag, sale urgency ("the cute prints always sell out first"). Shows putting it on sometimes, unboxing twice (8082a121, d6f4d802), a competitor hip seat vs sling comparison twice (b27616b4, 023ea274).
- What worked: every one of 62 approved. The July and early August talking videos got 2 ads each (Velcro/chores stories 0ec46022, 6c730b17, 611b09d3, d2414bee, 972f3de8; the competitor rant b27616b4; baby shower gift ca458daf; 23dd42e5, 86dd4da4, cc4d8dc7, ecf1ebf3, fc5dcd71). From mid August onward each got 1 ad, and the Sep 22 batch of 5 has none yet. Overall ROAS 1.56 on $9.5K spend. Fatima praised the safety check video 5e8ebf86 ("love how you highlighted the value prop") and b27616b4 ("Awesome!"). Her own comments on 972f3de8 ("I'm so sorry, I didn't even notice that!") and 92eed921 ("This one should be much better!") show she has fixed things when asked.
- Other people in her videos: a lot of the b-roll montages mix her with a second mom (dark hair, leopard sling, younger blonde baby, mentions an "8yo daughter") and other faces: 2f2d4b00, 334795aa, 15e0b1c6, ccdb82b0, e7dae67a, 12a3d769, 482acd47, 54ffeb94, 58c6f3e0, 17e5b274. Several of these ran as ads. Worth confirming who that is and that she agreed to paid use.
- Safety and checklist issues seen:
  - 810ef5e1 (Aug 18, ran as ad): her older daughter, about 7, wears the toddler in the sling ("Little mama wanted to try wearing baby sis"). A child carrying a toddler should not be in an ad. Suggest pausing it.
  - 58c6f3e0 (montage, 2 ads): the other mom nurses with the sling pulled over the baby "as a cover", baby's face hidden. Fails check 4 (face visible).
  - Hands off baby: 972f3de8 opens with "no hands, no hands" (hands free, a retired claim); 3331359c spins with both arms out; e512dd43 and a0850e59 hair flips; 0c8b69d3 arm in the air; ccdb82b0 and 2f2d4b00 show a mom doing her makeup/eyebrows with both hands while baby is in the sling. Fails check 2.
  - 7253d07a says "keep wearing them until your baby's like three years old": an age claim, should be 10 to 50 lbs. 3a68a35d and 7d9d5538 say it correctly.
  - Old promo text: 3331359c "buy 1 get 1 free", 12a3d769 "free clip-on bag when you buy 3". Check they are not still running with a dead offer.
  - Burned-in captions on nearly every talking video (check 6), minor since they ran fine.
  - Good: 5e8ebf86 is a clean safety tutorial (seat centred, M shape, bum below knee, one arm always, safety strap round the buckle). Seat under the bottom looks right in almost every talking video.
- Strengths: prolific (about 5 a week), natural on camera, strong opening lines, knows the product claims well, happy to do comparisons, unboxings and the clip-on bag.
- To improve: keep one hand on Goldie every frame (no spins or hair flips), drop hands free wording, and lean less on "sale ends soon" so the videos stay usable after a promo ends.
